title: Reconcile legacy local connector table shape before tunnel seed

phases.objective: Reconcile the legacy local_connector_user_configs table created by migration 017 before migration 032 seeds tunnel_url.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The exact ordered migration chain applies migration 030 before migration 032.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The existing local_connector_user_configs table has tunnel_url before the migration 032 INSERT, so the bundle build continues fail-closed only for real contract violations.
steps: Migration 017 creates the legacy local connector table shape.
Migration 030 creates the current local connector tables and explicitly adds tunnel_url if absent.
Migration 032 adds connector_secret and seeds tunnel_url through the existing table contract.
The schema bundle remains exact-SHA, three-role, schema-only, and production/provider isolated.
assertions: Migration 030 contains an idempotent ALTER for tunnel_url after device_id.
Migration 032's seed columns are covered by the reconciled table shape.
The ordered filenames remain 017 before 030 before 032.
No Production or provider access is introduced.
